snapshot.text: Universal coverage through GeSY, the general health system launched in 2019, now with more than one million beneficiaries. Nursing shortages, public hospital capacity and delays in treatment abroad are current pressure points.

priorities.title: Nursing workforce shortage
priorities.text: The health minister warns that nursing shortages threaten the quality of care.

priorities.title: Upgrading public hospitals within GeSY
priorities.text: GeSY reforms aim to upgrade public hospitals, which compete with private providers inside the system.

priorities.title: Treatment abroad under scrutiny
priorities.text: After delays in processing applications for treatment abroad, the minister defended overseas care as a complement to GeSY, not a replacement.
